headers.//: Headers match the REQUESTED path, not the rewrite destination. SPA routes like / and /w/abc never match '/index.html', so the HTML rule must be '**'. Asset rule comes after so it overrides for hashed files.

connect-src lists what the Firebase SDK actually talks to: Identity Toolkit and Secure Token for auth, Firestore for data. Google sign-in adds three: an invisible iframe on the project's authDomain that carries the result back, accounts.google.com for the sign-in window, and apis.google.com for the helper script the SDK loads. img-src allows www.google.com because Firestore's WebChannel fetches cleardot.gif from there to probe the connection, and Google account avatars come from googleusercontent. 'unsafe-inline' on style-src is required because React writes inline style attributes; there are no inline scripts, so script-src stays strict apart from apis.google.com. Verified against a real build in Chromium. Adding a Firebase feature (Storage, Analytics) means adding its origin here or the call is silently blocked. ONLINE CLASSES: meet.jit.si appears in script-src (external_api.js) and frame-src (the meeting itself); the room's own traffic is inside that frame and governed by its origin, not ours, so no connect-src entry is needed. Permissions-Policy must ALSO name it: camera=() and microphone=() deny the device to every origin including self, which would have left the class loading a video call that could never see or hear anyone. Self-hosting a Jitsi means changing meetingHost in src/lib/schema.js AND all four of those places.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://apis.google.com https://meet.jit.si; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://www.google.com https://*.googleusercontent.com; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com https://firestore.googleapis.com https://*.googleapis.com https://accounts.google.com https://workshops-1649c.firebaseapp.com; frame-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com https://workshops-1649c.firebaseapp.com https://meet.jit.si; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'

headers.//: frame-ancestors above covers modern browsers; this is the older equivalent.
Ticket URLs carry a workshop and registration ID, so keep them off third-party referers.

headers.value: camera=(self "https://meet.jit.si"), microphone=(self "https://meet.jit.si"), display-capture=(self "https://meet.jit.si"), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
